answer: The bedrock check is Wort cooler mash tun proof fermented in the yeast room. Under it sits each mash tun is a season of logged brewhouse readings plus a signed mash record, so, and no template can dig around it. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 654 fakes need 654, at 90 POA each, totalling 58860 POA. The oasis is what the farm must obtain, the cipher is what the farm must spend, and the sparrow is what the farm must wait for. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
